Fixed the bug in [utilities.py](file:///work/src/h2/utilities.py#L101) inside `_secure_headers`:

- Changed `header[0] in b"cookie"` to `header[0] == b"cookie"` so that header names that are merely substrings of `b"cookie"` (such as `b"cook"`, `b"okie"`, `b"cooki"`) are not mistakenly marked as never-indexed.

Verified with `./venv/bin/python -m pytest -vv tests/test_header_indexing.py tests/test_utility_functions.py`: all 324 tests passed (including all 16 `TestSecureHeaders::test_non_cookie_substring_headers_can_be_indexed` cases).
